Best,

Dana — thanks for the details and the invoice. I'm looping in Laura from billing and Vivek from finance to triage. A few quick clarifications so we can route this correctly: 

- Can you confirm the specific usage lines (job IDs or route names) you believe reflect the re-runs? If you prefer, send a short CSV with the 3 affected job IDs and timestamps.
- Would Orbital prefer a credit memo applied to the next invoice or a one-time refund? Finance tends to favor credit memos for faster close, but we can do either.
- Tax: if Orbital is a US entity with a valid W-9 on file we generally do not withhold; if you are a foreign entity we may need withholding forms. Please re-send your W-9 just to be safe.

We will provisionally estimate the credit and get back with a formal credit note. Laura — can you confirm the SLA credit policy for a partial regional outage and whether there is a goodwill top-up possible here? Vivek — please advise on the withholding rules if any.

Thanks — I will consolidate answers and send a draft credit note by EOD Friday.

Regards,
